project_info.theme: JNX-style partner power sale with voucher and selected-order gift
project_info.color_palette: Pale Yellow, Black, White, Ultimate Sup Yellow, Partner Accent Colors

main_subject.detail: A pale-yellow poster with an Ultimate Sup x REF_PARTNER_LOGO lock-up, large {{EVENT_MARK}} {{EVENT_NAME}}, a white voucher card, a black gift card, floating corner REF_PARTNER_PRODUCTS, and bottom CTA.
main_subject.style: Bold fitness ecommerce offer poster, label-facing packshots, stacked card hierarchy

composition_elements.type: Partner lock-up / voucher card / gift card / packshot corners
items: Upper Middle: Oversized event mark and event name with a supporting line.
Center: White rectangular voucher card displaying {{VOUCHER_LABEL}} and {{VOUCHER_VALUE}}.
Lower Middle: Black gift card with REF_GIFT_PRODUCTS, {{GIFT_LABEL}}, and {{GIFT_DESCRIPTION}}.
Corners: Cropped REF_PARTNER_PRODUCTS as framing elements.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Warm pale-yellow glow, product rim shadows, strong black-card contrast

technical_specs.render_style: High fidelity partner-brand ecommerce offer poster

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: Create a square Ultimate Sup x REF_PARTNER_LOGO power-sale poster. Preserve the pale-yellow canvas, partner lock-up at top, big {{EVENT_MARK}} {{EVENT_NAME}}, white central voucher card with {{VOUCHER_LABEL}} {{VOUCHER_VALUE}}, black lower gift card with REF_GIFT_PRODUCTS and {{GIFT_LABEL}}, cropped REF_PARTNER_PRODUCTS in corners, and rounded black {{CTA}} at bottom. Maintain packshot fidelity and simple stacked offer hierarchy.
prompt.negative_prompt: wrong partner logo, unreadable voucher value, unapproved product/gift, distorted containers, missing CTA, unsupported claim, watermark, cluttered card hierarchy

assets.name: Power-sale voucher-and-gift layout
assets.usage: Preserve top lock-up, central voucher card, lower gift card, corner product framing, and CTA.

assets.name: Partner brand logo
assets.usage: Use only for active partner campaign.

assets.name: Selected-order gifts
assets.usage: Place within lower black gift card.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach all active partner assets. Build exact voucher values, expiry terms, and gift eligibility in post-production after commercial approval.

substitutable_fields.default: 8.8 / POWER SALE / Fuel harder workouts with exclusive deals

substitutable_fields.replacement_rule: Use current approved SGD voucher terms.
Use only verified gift eligibility and assets.
